pageProps.title: Bubing
pageProps.review: We introduce honest visit reviews and menu information for the milk red bean shaved ice, which is not sweet and has a clean taste, tasted at Cafe Bubing located in Bukchon, Jongno-gu, Seoul.
pageProps.content: ## Ordered ```menu { "title": "Red Bean Shaved Ice", "rating": 3.5 } --- Plain milk shaved ice ``` ## Review The most basic red bean shaved ice is milk shaved ice, and it wasn't very sweet. I haven't tried other fruit shaved ice, but personally, I know a shaved ice that is on another level, so it didn't satisfy me. ## Pictures
